query: SELECT w.series_id, s.canonical_title AS series_title, s.cover_url, COALESCE(rp.last_read_whole_number, 0)::float8 AS "last_read_number!", agg.next_number::float8 AS next_number, agg.unread AS "unread!" FROM watchlist_entries w JOIN series s ON s.id = w.series_id LEFT JOIN read_progress rp ON rp.user_id = w.user_id AND rp.series_id = w.series_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT min(c.number) FILTER ( WHERE floor(c.number) > COALESCE(rp.last_read_whole_number, 0) AND NOT (c.number <> floor(c.number) AND rp.last_read_part_number IS NOT NULL AND c.number <= rp.last_read_part_number) ) AS next_number, COALESCE(count(DISTINCT floor(c.number)) FILTER ( WHERE floor(c.number) > COALESCE(rp.last_read_whole_number, 0) AND NOT (c.number <> floor(c.number) AND rp.last_read_part_number IS NOT NULL AND c.number <= rp.last_read_part_number) ), 0) AS unread, max(c.discovered_at) AS last_activity FROM series_sources ss JOIN chapters c ON c.series_source_id = ss.id WHERE ss.series_id = w.series_id ) agg WHERE w.user_id = $1 AND w.status IN ('reading','planned','paused') AND agg.unread > 0 ORDER BY agg.last_activity DESC NULLS LAST, w.series_id
